# Git and DevOps Engineering
Inspect current changes and workflows. Never commit, push, publish, or deploy without approval. Preserve CI test and Pages behavior. Define backend-before-frontend deployment order only in a release plan. Include rollback, secret isolation, and production verification. Never expose private configuration in source.
